output.explanation: NIG-UK invoiced GBP 2,100.00 (NIG-UK:1900045367, ref 9000010492) for Microsoft 365 E5 licences, but NIG-SA booked GBP 1,785.00 (NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018997) net of 15% WHT, as its description states. output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should book the GBP 315.00 withheld tax to a WHT payable account (and remit it to the Saudi tax authority), and NIG-UK should record the WHT receivable and obtain the withholding certificate so the IC balance is cleared at the gross amount.
